name: the_rotation_subtracts_the_other_way
subs: F(7) = F(7) - F(3);               /* sin * first - cos * second */

name: the_sin_times_first_uses_second
subs: F(2) = F(2) * F(8);               /* sin * second instead */

name: the_mac_uses_sin_not_cos
subs: F(2) = fmaf(F(0), F(4), F(2));    /* sin * second + first * cos, fused */
F(2) = fmaf(F(0), F(5), F(2));    /* sin * second + first * sin, fused */

name: the_stored_first_and_second_swap
subs:
fstore(a, R(5), F(7));            /* first float of the record */
        fstore(a, R(7), F(8));            /* second float of the record */

fstore(a, R(5), F(8));            /* first float of the record */
        fstore(a, R(7), F(7));            /* second float of the record */

name: the_third_coordinate_load_uses_second_offset
subs: F(5) = fload(a, R(4) + R(0));         /* the second coordinate */
F(5) = fload(a, R(4) + R(0) + 4u);    /* wrong coordinate */

name: the_record_first_float_reads_the_second_slot
subs: F(9) = fload(a, R(5));            /* the record's first float */
F(9) = fload(a, R(5) + 8u);       /* the record's second float instead */
